---
title: "Phylogenetic Tree Generation"
author: "Ryan Wong"
date: "2025-05-22"
output: html_document
---

# Load the 'ape' library
```{r}

library(ape)

```

#Read in file as matrix
```{r}

dist_matrix <- as.matrix(read.table("Z:/mayor_lab/RyanWong/+_-_Laccase/Cladogram/1011DistanceMatrixBasedOnSNPs.tab", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")) #Dataset from Peter J, et al. 2018 (Nature)

```

# Convert the matrix to a 'dist' object
```{r}

dist_object <- as.dist(dist_matrix)

```

# Construct a Neighbor Joining tree
```{r}

tree <- nj(dist_object)

```

# Save the tree in Newick format
```{r}

write.tree(tree, file = "Z:/mayor_lab/RyanWong/+_-_Laccase/Cladogram/1011_tree_SNPs.nwk")

```
